subject: Service clarity and remediation brief — Clearsight impact and commitments
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Service clarity and remediation brief — Clearsight impact and commitments

Hi Rajiv,

Thank you again for the time earlier. I wanted to follow up with a concise customer-facing summary of what we know so far, immediate mitigations we applied, and the commitments you can expect from Redwood. This is intended to be a clear, single-page brief you can share with your execs and engineering leads.

Summary of what happened
- What: Short-lived inference latency spike impacting ~4% of requests to your dedicated pool for ~18 minutes.
- When: 2026-11-24 18:03–18:21 UTC (11/24 10:03–10:21 PT).
- Impact: Elevated P95 latency from 220ms -> 2.3s; no data loss; no model state corruption.

Immediate mitigations we put in place
- Rolled back a recent kernel selection change on the affected pool (completed 18:15 UTC).
- Enabled conservative batching and temporarily pinned requests to the previous model variant.
- Added a short-term routing policy to route mission-critical routes to alternate capacity while we investigated.

What we're delivering to you by end of week
- Draft RCA with timeline and technical findings (attached draft).
- A list of action owners and target dates for fixes and verification.
- A 30-minute technical walkthrough with our infra team next week to go through logs and test mitigations.

Next steps / ask from Clearsight
- Please confirm whether you want the walkthrough focused on (a) latency root cause or (b) the SLA/credit calculation and timeline. We can split into two sessions if helpful.
- Any specific slices of traffic (routes, model versions) you'd like us to prioritize in the verification tests.

Attachments: clearsight_rca_draft.pdf; impact_timeline.csv

I will circulate the final RCA after we validate the telemetry. Expect the final email from me no later than 2026-11-29 EOD PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final RCA and remediation commitments — Clearsight impact (attached)

Hi Rajiv and team,

Thanks for the clarifying questions — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is the final RCA (clearsight_rca_final.pdf) and a compact impact_timeline.csv. Below is a short plain-language explanation and the concrete commitments we are making.

Plain-language summary of technical finding
- Root cause: An automated kernel-selection heuristic we shipped to the fleet selected a non-optimal attention kernel for the workload characteristics present in your traffic profile. Under a short burst of requests with varied sequence lengths, the kernel caused increased scheduling overhead and inefficient GPU utilization, which produced a transient latency spike for a subset of requests. In simple terms: an optimizer chose the wrong low-level routine for a particular traffic pattern.

Why only some requests were affected
- The heuristic decision was made per-request window and depended on observed sequence-length distribution. Only ~4% of requests matched the decision path that led to the expensive kernel; the rest used the stable execution path.

Concrete customer commitments and timelines
- Code fix: Replace the heuristic with a fallback-safe selector. Target complete: 2026-12-06. Owner: Markus Klein.
- Post-deploy verification: 48-hour synthetic and production canary. Target start: 2026-12-07. Owner: Redwood SREs.
- SLA/credit calculation: Draft example calculation included in appendix. We will finalize the credit within 3 business days after you confirm baseline usage. Owner: Neha Kapoor.
- Operability: Add an automatic rollback trigger (latency-based) and alerting rule so similar regressions route traffic to safe capacity automatically. Target: 2026-12-10. Owner: Markus Klein.

Attachments: clearsight_rca_final.pdf; impact_timeline.csv; action_owners.xlsx
Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-clearsight-rca-final
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/CLR-2026-0917

Scheduling: Rajiv — we confirmed Wed 2026-11-30 09:30 PT for a 30-minute walkthrough with our infra and SRE team. Calendar invite to follow.

If you prefer, we can also provide a short one-page exec summary tailored for your board.
